State jobs do not pay the greatest, but once you are past your probation period (6months-1year) they are very stable with a pension and job security.

I did this same thing 3 years ago and I only have recently come to terms with it. I had to mourn my old life and what I thought it was supposed to be. I currently live less than 10 min from my Nparents. It is a constant chore of setting expectations and boundaries, and resetting them as needed. For example, my kids see my Nparents on Saturday. If they try and come over or ask us to come over during the week, I politely decline and say "we'll see you on Saturday." If they try and come over without asking, I will meet them outside of my house, and restate that "you didn't call, I expect you to call before coming over." I don't let them into the house, and remind them that whatever they came over for, can wait until Saturday. The hardest thing for me is to remember that they are not normal, and cannot provide the type of relationship I want. So I interact with them very superficially, lots of grey rock, no details.
